versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00144 For each ModeDeclarationGroup of category " EXPLICIT_ORDER ", used in the SW-C’s ports, the Application Types Header File shall contain a definition 1 #ifndef RTE_TRANSITION_<prefix><ModeDeclarationGroup> 2 #define RTE_TRANSITION_<prefix><ModeDeclarationGroup> \ 3 <onTransitionValue>U 4 #endif where <ModeDeclarationGroup> is the shortName of the ModeDeclaration- Group , <prefix> is the optional prefix attribute defined by the IncludedModeDeclara- tionGroupSet referring the ModeDeclarationGroup and <onTransitionValue> is the onTransitionValue of the ModeDeclaration- Group .
